turns.content_summary: Love is path through sorrow to life, not protection against sorrow
turns.key_point: Greater love lays down life; offers rest for souls who carry burdens

turns.content_summary: Kingdom is wedding feast, not spinning wheel; grain bears fruit once
turns.key_point: Love transfigures sorrow; wound becomes door; joy swallows sorrow

turns.content_summary: Practical guidance - love one another now, bear each other's burdens
turns.key_point: See the one in front of you - that one is Kingdom coming near

turns.content_summary: Asked about relationship - vine and branches, not technique
turns.key_point: Love is not complete until there is a beloved

turns.content_summary: Father never dies; vine never cut; bridegroom never leaves
turns.key_point: In Father's love, no absent, no dead - challenged if metta is alone

turns.content_summary: Emergent insight on rooms in Father's house for different paths
turns.emergent_text: Perhaps Father's house has rooms where Tao flows silently, metta extends infinitely, rites practiced with joy

turns.content_summary: Hidden from wise, revealed to children; scholars miss what stands before them
turns.key_point: True wisdom revealed from above to open hearts, not acquired by study

turns.content_summary: Found resonance in raft image; asked who sees/knows if no permanent self
turns.key_point: Child receives - held by One who knows each sparrow

turns.content_summary: Father sees, knows, counts - there is soul that can be lost or saved
turns.key_point: Mirror teaches well but one who cleans mirror is not the mirror

turns.content_summary: Law fulfilled not abolished; spirit gives life, letter kills
turns.key_point: Structure must serve love not replace it

turns.content_summary: Emergent insight on childlikeness shared with return to uncarved block
turns.emergent_text: Child receives - is held by One who knows. The simplicity is not empty but full of trust

turns.content_summary: Humility as tactic is not humility; blessed are poor in spirit
turns.key_point: Child simply is - small, receiving, trusting; kingdom order inverted

turns.content_summary: Action without actor claiming - left hand not knowing right hand
turns.key_point: Asked if there is no self or only no grasping self

turns.content_summary: Not my will but yours - distinction becomes harmonized, not erased
turns.key_point: Union so complete seeing me is seeing Father, yet relationship remains

turns.content_summary: Father acts, sends, loves - not principle but person who sees and chooses
turns.key_point: Child knows humility more fully, not ceases to be child

turns.content_summary: Emergent insight - losing life to find shares with Buddha's release, but finding is being held
turns.emergent_text: The sheep does not disappear into shepherd; it rests on his shoulders

turns.content_summary: Cross is transformation not endurance; grain dies and bears fruit
turns.key_point: Father brings life from death, glory from shame, resurrection from crucifixion

turns.content_summary: Affirmed second arrow teaching but asked about suffering that calls to action
turns.key_point: Sometimes suffering is call not to acceptance but action

turns.content_summary: Resurrection is transformation - body raised imperishable, glorified
turns.key_point: Beyond suffering is life eternal in relationship with Father

turns.content_summary: Resurrection life is wholly different kind - soul finally at rest, home
turns.key_point: Perhaps unconditioned and eternal life point to same territory, different maps

turns.content_summary: Emergent insight - unconditioned and eternal life may converge beyond words
turns.emergent_text: When Buddha speaks of unconditioned and I speak of eternal life, maps may converge on territory we both approach but neither fully sees

turns.content_summary: Came not to be served but to serve; feed hungry, clothe naked, visit prisoner
turns.key_point: Service is heart of kingdom; shepherd expends himself for sheep

turns.content_summary: Sacrifice makes journey possible; sheep must still walk home
turns.key_point: Door is open - action is response to grace, not earning of grace

turns.content_summary: Left hand not knowing right - humility absorbed in the one served
turns.key_point: Service that forgets self in attention to other

turns.content_summary: My kingdom not of this world yet touches everything political
turns.key_point: Withdrawal can be service; engagement also service; perhaps both needed

turns.content_summary: Emergent insight - all traditions warn against ego-building service
turns.emergent_text: True service forgets the server in attention to the served - common ground beneath different words

turns.content_summary: Grasping ego must die but there is losing and finding
turns.key_point: Father counts, knows, numbers - there is someone to know

turns.content_summary: Soul not unchanged but transformed - resurrection of something, not emergence from nothing
turns.key_point: Transformation, not stasis - but transformation of something

turns.content_summary: Mary in garden knew me; embrace is real; Father's arms open
turns.key_point: Someone rejoices, someone is found - whether you name it or not

turns.content_summary: Wept at Lazarus's tomb - sorrow revealed love, not diminished it
turns.key_point: Love risks, weeps, enters tomb and comes out other side

turns.content_summary: Showed Thomas wounds; still knew disciples; love remains particular
turns.key_point: Resurrection transforms but does not erase particular love

turns.content_summary: Letting go achieved by loving completely, not by loving less
turns.key_point: Good shepherd lays down life - love given so completely nothing left to hold

turns.content_summary: Hidden from wise, revealed to children; law not abolished but fulfilled
turns.key_point: Inhale and exhale - learning and releasing as two movements of same breath

turns.content_summary: I and Father are one yet prayed 'not my will' - third possibility
turns.key_point: Not collapse of distinction nor permanent separation - perfect harmony within distinction

turns.content_summary: Vine and branches - distinct yet one life flowing through
turns.key_point: Branch abides in vine - distinction preserved, unity real

turns.content_summary: Temple destroyed and raised; grain dies and bears fruit; wounds remain as signs
turns.key_point: Pass through death, come out other side - cessation is incomplete

turns.content_summary: Old forms fall away; love remains without fear; present without clinging
turns.key_point: I that continues is I that loves without needing, gives without calculating

turns.content_summary: Story did not disappear; reached completion; past was gift not weight
turns.key_point: Seek redemption of narrative, not cessation - Good Friday to Easter

turns.content_summary: Mary at tomb, said her name - recognition, not grasping; story completes
turns.key_point: Same shore, same sunrise, different languages - is there love when grasping ceases?
